status: PROPOSED design (unit COVERAGE, 2026-10-11). Nothing here is built, generated, placed or seen in game. The three existing dungeons' pools START with the species data/dungeons.json carries today, so a consumer that rolls from a pool still offers the approved prize. The thirteen proposed dungeons are proposals for the owner; four of them are the dungeons DUNGEONS.md 10 already lists (D18), nine are new. Read with docs/mechanics/LEGENDARY_COVERAGE.md.
why: The owner, 2026-10-11: 'Make sure all legendaries, mythicals, early power mons, and ultra beasts are placed in these dungeons if not in the world normally. If we can squeeze someone into the world, we should.' and 'make sure we have a lot of variety'. Pass 3's prize (DUNGEON_ROOMS.md 1b) names ONE species per band; a run here rolls one species from the band's POOL (the PRIZE-POOLS unit adds that to tools/dungeon_prize.py). Each legendary, mythical, Ultra Beast and paradox has exactly one home: a world site, a boss, or one dungeon's legendary pool (it may sit in several of that dungeon's bands). Rare non-legendary lines may repeat across dungeons: they are ordinary species.

consumer.fields: dungeons[].rare_pool_by_band and dungeons[].legendary_pool_by_band: {band (string '1'..'6'): [species id, ...]}. A band absent from both has no prize. The first entry of an existing dungeon's list is the species its habitat names today (data/dungeons.json params.prize).
consumer.not_consumed: species, world_proposals, fallback_homes, owner_calls and ub_boss are design records for the doc, the owner and the boss work; tools/ need read none of them
consumer.label_rule_for_the_tool: a legendary pool holds species the 1.8.0 jar labels legendary, mythical, ultra_beast OR paradox; a rare pool holds none of the four. tools/dungeon_prize.py LEGEND_LABELS today is {legendary, mythical, ultra_beast}: it would REFUSE every paradox below in a legendary pool and ACCEPT one as a rare prize. PRIZE-POOLS must add paradox (finding, LEGENDARY_COVERAGE.md 6).

rules.legendary_from_band_why: relayed from data/dungeons.json engine.prize.legendary_from_band and checked: data/gym_trainers.json generation_contract gym_ace_levels [20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55], the cap is the next required leader's ace, so a player holding gym 6's badge has cap 50, band 4 (caps 50, 55). data/progression.json carries no caps ('chapters carry no level_cap here'), so the brief's 'read from progression.json' could not be followed literally.
rules.restricted_band6_only: a species the 1.8.0 jar labels `restricted` (the box legendaries: Dialga, Palkia, Ho-Oh, Kyurem, Reshiram, Zekrom, Xerneas, Yveltal, Zacian, Zamazenta, Zygarde, Terapagos, Koraidon, Miraidon, Eternatus, ...) sits only in band 6 (cap 100, after the Champion). Every other legendary, mythical, Ultra Beast and paradox from band 4. The line is the jar's own label, not a tuned threshold. Arceus (mythical, not labelled restricted) is held to band 6 by hand as the capstone.
rules.rare_level_rule: a rare prize spawns at its band's lower cap (20, 30, 40: engine.prize.level). A middle stage is offered in a band only if its natural evolution level (1.8.0 jar) is at most 10 above that level: band 1 at most 30 (Metang 20, Gabite 24, Pupitar 30, Dragonair 30, Shelgon 30), band 2 at most 40 (Fraxure 38, Hakamo-o 35, Arctibax 35, Doublade 35, Sliggoo 40), band 3 at most 50 (Zweilous 50, Drakloak 50, Lampent 41). Base stages at any band. TWO EXISTING ENTRIES BREAK IT and are kept because the owner approved them (DUNGEON_PASS2.md, 2026-10-10: 'these dungeons are hard and getting through one would mean they deserve it'): Hakamo-o at band 1 (35, 15 over) and Sliggoo at band 1 (40, 20 over).
rules.paradox: the owner, 2026-10-08: paradoxes are dungeon content, 'late dungeons, as threats and rare rewards, chosen by each dungeon's theme'. Here they sit only in legendary pools, so no paradox is met before gym 6 (band 4) in any dungeon, and each is placed by its theme. Flutter Mane is a starter line (STATE 157) and stays placed.
rules.boss_legendaries: D18's boss legendaries (Yveltal, Dialga, Heatran; Entei built) stay BOSS catches, never pool entries: one home each. D18's lake legendaries (Palkia, Suicune, Walking Wake, Tapu Fini) go into pools, as the Night Shift's lake Volcanion became its pass-3 prize.
rules.ultra_beasts: each of the nine unused Ultra Beasts is in exactly one dungeon's legendary pool (its catch, Beast Ball, band 4+) and is that dungeon's proposed boss (ub_boss, ULTRA_BEAST_BOSSES.md). Recommended: the boss stays NPC-held at every band (fight-only, the built chain) and the catch is the hidden prize, which makes that document's wild band-6 stage (E-P6) unnecessary for Ultra Beasts.
rules.model_gate: atm_subset: the species' only model is in ATMxMSD (modpack/manifest/client-pack-atm-subset.json lists it). The owner decided the AllTheMons subset goes to players directly (STATE 157); until a player's client has it the species renders as the doll. A consumer may drop gated species from a pool until delivery.
